symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of an array, counting the d-1 cyclic axes plus the coefficient axis.
symbols.quote: The algorithm uses arrays with $d-1$ cyclic axes, so $d$ counts the cyclic axes plus the coefficient axis, and $t_i$ is the length of cyclic axis $i$.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of cyclic axis i.
symbols.quote: The algorithm uses arrays with $d-1$ cyclic axes, so $d$ counts the cyclic axes plus the coefficient axis, and $t_i$ is the length of cyclic axis $i$.

symbols.name: address count
symbols.meaning: The number of cyclic addresses of an array, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Let $M=\prod_{i<d}t_i$ be the number of cyclic addresses, and $T=rM$ the total number of complex coefficients in an array.

symbols.name: coefficient count
symbols.meaning: The total number of complex coefficients in an array.
symbols.quote: Let $M=\prod_{i<d}t_i$ be the number of cyclic addresses, and $T=rM$ the total number of complex coefficients in an array.
